evidence:
Symptom: in the app's How-to sheet, opening the barbell back squat 'bar-on-back' posture close-up (HT-7) from Mistake mode, the SVG text label 'Bony bump' sometimes lays out to width 25.2705 instead of 25.3114 (CTM 1.91058), giving an L3 pixel diff of 881 px vs golden B at rest. Neighbour label 'Right' (.h-head) is always 32.3478 everywhere.
Rates: single browser, 8 busy cores: 16/90 to 14/120 bad depending on variant; gate load (6 browsers, 4 busy cores): app 42/300 (0 to 13 of 30 per theme). Golden B page (same file, same load): 0/300. Instant scroll earlier 0/90 on the pre-HT-6-merge host, but 4/120 after merge.
Failed fixes: (a) re-attach every <text> node after zoom ends: 16/90, none recovered (stays 25.2705); font-size flip+restore+reflow: none recovered. (b) zoom paused until scrollend: 4-7/90-120. (d) rAF integer scrollTop smooth scroll: 36/120. (e) instant scrollIntoView: 4/120. (g1) wait 2 frames after clearMistake() before measuring/animating: 14/120; (g2) g1+instant: 0/120 single browser but 9/30 and 17/30 under gate load (unchanged 0c3cfd8: 7/30, 13/30). (h) pre-warm: render each close-up's SVG text once hidden, untransformed, in the zoom slot on the frame after the chunk loads, then remove: 100/300 (worse). (i) force golden B's exact face (an 'Inter' woff2 face, display block, full range) on the crop text: 7/120; text-size-adjust:auto: 19/120.
Static: laying the label out at a fixed CSS scale 0.88-1 then back to 1 always gives 25.3114, even on a cold first layout.
Per-frame trace of a bad open (rAF page clock): panel hidden 4 frames (scrollTop 396), then shown with the zoom animation running from 0 ms and scrollTop jumping to 84 in one frame, animation runs to 233 ms, ends; label 25.2705. A good open traces identically and ends 25.3114. No extra layout/scroll/frame from app code.
Cache test: in a bad tab, a FRESH <text>Bony bump</text> added beside the label (same parent, CTM 1.91058) also measures 25.2705; in a fresh tab of the same browser context the same fresh label measures 25.3114; the first tab keeps 25.2705. Later opens in a loop can come out good again (state set per open, then held).
Fonts: app registers family 'Inter Variable' src woff2-variations display swap unicode-range latin; golden B registers 'Inter' woff2 display block full range; both the same file bytes inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2 (sha256 3100e775...). CDP getPlatformFontsForNode: Inter / Inter-Regular custom font, 9 glyphs, in golden, good app and bad app. All computed font props identical good vs bad (family, size, weight, style, stretch, optical-sizing, variation/feature settings, kerning, synthesis, letter-spacing -0.135px, smoothing, text-rendering). App vs golden differ only in text-size-adjust (100% vs auto).
Environment: Playwright Chromium 1194 build at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium, Linux, headless, likely deviceScaleFactor 2 mobile emulation at 390x844; app sheet is a dialog with an overflow-scrolling panel; golden B scrolls the window; zoom animation = Web Animations panel.animate([{opacity:0, transform:'scale(.9)'},{opacity:1, transform:'none'}], 240ms).
